  • Uses of CombustionCalculator in neqsim.process.util.combustion

    Methods in neqsim.process.util.combustion that return CombustionCalculator
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.calibrateCoFromMeasuredPpmv(double measuredCoPpmv, double measuredExhaustO2VolPercent)
    Calibrate the CO emission factor from a single field measurement (CEMS / stack test): the measured CO ppmv at the measured exhaust O2 is compared with the current uncalibrated prediction (corrected to the same O2), and a multiplicative calibration factor is stored so subsequent calculate() calls reproduce the measurement and scale it to other loads on a fuel-energy basis.
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.calibrateNoxFromMeasuredPpmv(double measuredNoxPpmv, double measuredExhaustO2VolPercent)
    Calibrate the NOx emission factor from a single field measurement, analogous to calibrateCoFromMeasuredPpmv(double, double).
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.enableThermalCoScaling(double referenceFlameTempK)
    Enable thermal-CO scaling so that the CO emission factor responds to the computed adiabatic flame temperature with the opposite trend to NOx: a hotter, more complete flame (a heavier or more hydrogen-rich fuel, air preheat, or tighter excess air) oxidises CO more fully and lowers it, while a cooler flame raises it.
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.enableThermalNoxScaling(double referenceFlameTempK)
    Enable Zeldovich thermal-NOx scaling so that the NOx emission factor rises and falls with the computed adiabatic flame temperature.
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.setAirFlowRate(double kgPerHr)
    Put the calculator in air-driven mode by fixing the combustion-air mass flow.
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.setAnnualOperatingHours(double hours)
    Set the annual operating hours used to roll the pollutant mass rates up to tonnes/year (permit / annual-report basis).
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.setAssumedFuelH2sPpmv(double ppmv)
    Set an assumed fuel-gas H2S content, used only when the fuel fluid carries no sulphur species, so a screening SO2 rate can still be reported.
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.setBurnerType(CombustionCalculator.BurnerType type)
    Select a burner technology from the built-in database, which sets the NOx and CO emission factors to that technology's typical values.
    CombustionCalculator
    CombustionCalculator.setCh4SlipFactorGPerGJ(double gPerGJ)
    Set the unburned-methane (CH4 slip) emission factor on fuel LHV energy.
    CombustionCalculator

    Set a multiplicative field-calibration factor on the CO emission factor (1.0 = model default).
